g.text: You are braver than you believe. – Christopher Robin

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif

g.text: 你比你想象的更勇敢。——克里斯托弗·罗宾

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

g.text: Life is like a box of chocolates, you never know what you're gonna get.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif

g.text: 生活就像一盒巧克力，你永远不知道下一颗是什么味道。——《阿甘正传》

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

g.text: It is not our abilities that show what we truly are, it is our choices.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif

g.text: 决定我们成为什么样的人，不是我们的能力，而是我们的选择。——《哈利·波特》
